themes.label: Index Rotation, Not Rollover
themes.narrative: Index-level calm implies broad health, with SPY at 778.57 (+0.6% today, +2.74% 1m) only -0.4% from its 52-week high.
themes.dataAnchor: Market concentration reads ROTATION_NOT_ROLLOVER: Mag7 averages -9.33% from its 52-week high, a -8.93-point gap to SPY, with TSLA weakest at -23.3% and AAPL strongest at -2.5%. Bank lending standards are LOOSE at SLOOS 0%, well below the ~40% stress threshold, and IWM lags at -3.09% 1m and -6.2% 3m despite SPY and QQQ gains.
themes.counterRead: The divergence is real rotation, not a confirmed rollover, because credit remains loose - but leadership is narrow and small caps are not confirming. Treat index strength as selective, not broad permission to add.
themes.watchFor: SLOOS moving toward 40% or the Mag7-vs-SPY gap widening beyond -8.93 points would change the rotation read.

themes.label: High Rates, Tight Credit, Calm Equities
themes.narrative: Equities and volatility imply the rate backdrop is manageable, with VIX at 14.84 (-3.7% today, -16.82% 1m) and QQQ +6.02% 1m.
themes.dataAnchor: Rates are not low: DGS10 is 5.24%, DGS30 is 5.6%, DGS2 is 4.77%, the 2s10s curve is 0.47 and real 10y is 2.89%. HY OAS is tight at 3.09%, and the Sep CPI event on 2026-10-14 is flagged HIGH signal strength with the Oct 27-28 FOMC also HIGH.
themes.counterRead: Price is running ahead of the rate data: tight credit and a falling VIX are supporting equities while nominal and real yields stay elevated. A hot CPI print would test that calm directly, so equity complacency is the risk, not credit stress today.
themes.watchFor: The Oct 14 CPI print and whether DGS10 holds above 5.24% or HY OAS widens materially from 3.09% would change this read.

themes.label: Dislocated Quality Growth
themes.narrative: The tape has left former growth leaders for dead, pricing APP, AVGO, NOW and NXT as broken stories rather than recovering businesses.
themes.dataAnchor: AVGO is top conviction at score 81, Tier A, -27% from its high with revenue +55% YoY, 67.8% gross margin and $26,914M FCF. APP is -62.5% from its high (RSI 35.4) and a watchlist promotion at score 70 with revenue recovery, NOW is -27% with revenue +23.1% YoY, and NXT is -47.2% with revenue growth cited at 31.6% in its promotion thesis.
themes.counterRead: Fundamentals are ahead of price here: all four watchlist promotions are flagged RECOVERY, and the pullback posture is RESEARCH_SCREENED across 24 dislocations. This is the opportunity side of the rotation - verify thesis before sizing, per the screen, rather than chasing the 1m leaders.
themes.watchFor: A promotion from watchlist to conviction, or AVGO/APP/NOW/NXT reclaiming trend with RSI holding above 50, would confirm the data-ahead read.

themes.label: AI Power Bifurcation
themes.narrative: The AI-power narrative treats operating power and pre-commercial nuclear as one trade.
themes.dataAnchor: They are diverging: VST is +9.5% 1m and +3.13% today (still -25.6% from its high, RSI 64.4), while SMR is -29.58% 1m, OKLO -13.04% 1m and URA -13.8% 1m. ASTS is -14.99% 1m and -10.54% today, in the same speculative laggard group.
themes.counterRead: The market is paying for operating power exposure (VST, also PWR +14.1% 1m and GEV +8.57% 1m among leaders) and discounting the speculative nuclear names. A blanket AI-power narrative is ahead of that split - own the distinction, not the theme label.
themes.watchFor: SMR or OKLO reversing their 1m declines of -29.58% and -13.04% while VST holds above its current 161.48 level would challenge the bifurcation read.

themes.label: Momentum Leaders Extended
themes.narrative: The 1m leaderboard implies momentum itself is the thesis, led by PLTR, PWR and HIMS.
themes.dataAnchor: PLTR is +25.8% 1m and +4.97% today, PWR +14.1% 1m, HIMS +12.72% 1m and +10.23% today, and META +11.36% 1m. SPY by comparison is +2.74% 1m, so leadership is running roughly 4-9x the index pace with no fundamental anchor for these names in this input.
themes.counterRead: Without a data anchor in this input to support the pace, these moves are narrative ahead of verified fundamentals. They confirm risk appetite alongside VIX at 14.84, but they are not the screened opportunity - that sits in the dislocated names.
themes.watchFor: PLTR failing to hold its 1m pace or HIMS reversing its +10.23% day while VIX rises from 14.84 would signal momentum exhaustion.

strategyPosture: Stay selective midday: SPY is -0.4% from its high with loose credit (SLOOS 0%), but high rates (10y 5.24%) and narrow rotation argue against chasing extended 1m leaders; the screened work is in DATA_AHEAD dislocations like AVGO, APP, NOW and NXT, sized only after thesis verification.
whereWaveBuilds: The next move most likely builds around the Oct 14 CPI print (HIGH signal) into the Oct 27-28 FOMC, where a rates surprise would first hit the narrow leadership and the dislocated growth names trading -27% to -62.5% from their highs.
watchFor: Oct 14 Sep CPI print (HIGH signal event cpi-2026-10-14) versus the current DGS10 at 5.24% and real 10y at 2.89%
HY OAS widening materially from 3.09% or SLOOS moving from 0% toward the ~40% stress threshold
Mag7-vs-SPY 52-week-high gap widening beyond -8.93 points, or IWM extending its -6.2% 3m lag
AVGO (score 81, -27% from high), APP, NOW or NXT converting watchlist promotion (scores 69-70, RECOVERY) into conviction promotion
VIX rising from 14.84 or SMR/OKLO reversing -29.58% / -13.04% 1m declines, which would break the AI-power bifurcation
